sloka: तदार्य कलुषा बुद्धिः जायते शस्त्र सेवनात् ।पुनर् गत्वात् तत् अयोध्यायाम् क्षत्र धर्मम् चरिष्यसि ॥३-९-२८॥
transliteration: tadārya kaluṣā buddhiḥ jāyate śastra sevanāt ।punar gatvāt tat ayodhyāyām kṣatra dharmam cariṣyasi ॥3-9-28॥

translations.english: Where is the question of wielding a weapon and living in the forest, where is the life of a kshatriya and the life of penance? For us, this is an encroachment. Let the law of the land be honoured.
